prompt: Screen recording of a design tool for one memory, a diegetic interface in a dark chamber. The top two thirds of the frame is a black chamber with a thin pale horizon line. The bottom third is a chrome cylindrical hand controller with five knurled rings and two small square keys, and above it a flat paper-white telemetry panel with small black text, a round dial and a progress list. Over ten seconds a birthday cake builds itself from nothing in the chamber: first a pale clay drum appears and settles on a hexagonal table, then white icing is piped in rings around it, then seven thin candles rise from the top and light one by one with small warm flames. With each step the controller's rings turn and the telemetry panel updates its text and bars. Static camera, the controller and panel stay in frame the whole time, calm precise motion, warm candle light on black.
